stories.title: Chinese man arrested after fabricating rooftop child grave hoax above residential flat

en.title: Chinese man arrested after fabricating rooftop child grave hoax above residential flat
en.summary: Police in southwestern China investigated and debunked a rumor about bones found on a residential rooftop. A man was arrested for fabricating the hoax that had alarmed a flat owner in Sichuan province.

stories.title: Mapping US chip supply chain: China accounts for far more than it appears, report says

en.title: Mapping US chip supply chain: China accounts for far more than it appears, report says
en.summary: China supplies about 5 percent of equipment and materials directly to the US chip industry by manufacture country, but controls over 90 percent of rare earths essential for chipmaking. Most US chipmaker spending on manufacturing equipment and materials comes from companies based in the US, Europe, and Japan.

en.summary: Trista Sun, a former HSBC managing director, has launched Equora, an AI-driven wealth management start-up targeting a billion-dollar valuation. The platform aims to help investors manage finances proactively through artificial intelligence agents.

en.title: China bets on molten salt and CO2 to help meet its power needs

en.title: Brake-pedal failures in luxury EV put Chinese cars' quality in regulatory spotlight
en.summary: Safety testing revealed brake-pedal failures in a Huawei-backed luxury EV, raising quality concerns. Chinese regulators have published draft rules to strengthen testing and oversight of new car models.

stories.title: Beijing police detain Yiren Digital chairman after massive product defaults

en.title: Beijing police detain Yiren Digital chairman after massive product defaults
en.summary: Chinese police have detained controllers of Yiren Digital, a US-listed digital lender, following a criminal investigation into related investment platforms that failed to repay investors for over four months. The Beijing authorities are investigating suspected illegal activities connected to CreditEase.
